data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Browser tab title of the Compare page.

data.name: Heading
data.comment: Heading of the Compare page before anything is compared.

data.name: EntryLink
data.comment: Link on the Wishlist and Available for swap pages that opens the Compare page.

data.name: Intro
data.value: See what your friend has from your wishlist, and what you have from theirs.

data.name: InputLabel
data.value: A link to their page, or a list they sent
data.comment: Label of the box where a friend's link or list is pasted.

data.name: Go
data.comment: Button under the box.

data.name: InputHint
data.value: Ask for the link to their Stikling page, or for the list they share from their wishlist or swap list.

data.name: PlainQuestion
data.value: Is this what they have, or what they're looking for?
data.comment: Asked when the pasted list is just names, so the app can't tell which it is.

data.name: PlainHave
data.comment: Answer to the question above.

data.name: PlainWant
data.comment: Answer to the question above.

data.name: ErrorEmpty
data.value: Paste a link or a list first.
data.comment: Shown when Compare is tapped with nothing in the box.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: Read by screen readers while the friend's page is fetched.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: There's no page at this address.

data.name: Gone
data.value: This page has been turned off.
data.comment: The owner turned their public page off.

data.name: Offline
data.value: Comparing with a page needs a connection. Pasting a list works offline.

data.name: Failed
data.value: Couldn't open that page right now. Try again in a bit.

data.name: PasteInstead
data.comment: Button under a problem with the friend's page, back to the box.

data.name: TheirList
data.comment: Title of the result when the friend's list was pasted and has no page title.

data.name: Change
data.comment: Link next to the counts that goes back to the box.

data.name: ForYou
data.comment: Heading of what the friend has that is on my wishlist. Shown in capitals.

data.name: ForThem
data.comment: Heading of what I have that is on the friend's wishlist. Shown in capitals.

data.name: TheyHaveIt
data.comment: Under one of their plants that is on my wishlist and isn't marked as spare.

data.name: TheyWant
data.comment: Under one of my plants. {0} is the name on their wishlist.

data.name: NoneForYou
data.value: None of their plants are on your wishlist.

data.name: NoneForThem
data.value: None of your plants are on their wishlist.

data.name: NoWishlistPage
data.value: Their page doesn't share a wishlist.

data.name: NoWishlistList
data.value: Their list doesn't include a wishlist.

data.name: MarkLabel
data.comment: Spoken name of the Up for swap button. {0} is the plant.

data.name: MarkedUpForSwap
data.comment: {0} is the plant.

data.name: NothingBody
data.value: None of their plants are on your wishlist, and none of yours are on theirs. Have a look at the rest of their plants.

data.name: More
data.comment: Folded heading. {0} is how many.

data.name: AddToWishlist
data.comment: Small button on one of their plants that adds it to my wishlist.

data.name: AddLabel
data.comment: Spoken name of the button above. {0} is the plant.

data.name: AddedToWishlist
data.comment: {0} is the plant.

data.name: Unread_One
data.comment: Folded line under the result that lists the lines of a pasted list that weren't names.

data.name: AskForSwap
data.comment: Button when their page has a way to get in touch.

data.name: SendReply
data.comment: Button when it has not.

data.name: ReplyTitle
data.comment: Title of the sheet with the message to send.

data.name: CopiedPaste
data.value: Copied. Paste it in your message.
data.comment: Shown after the reply was copied and their contact was opened.
